note: Skill -> deterministic-tool promotion catalog. The FORK direction on SkillClaw (AMAP-ML, MIT, WIP): instead of evolving a free-form SKILL.md and re-injecting it into the agent's probabilistic loop, we COMPILE a repeatedly-reused, held-out-validated skill into a DETERMINISTIC, schema-bounded, sandboxed, signed internal TOOL. This is the Determinism Factory (M0->M8 LLM->rule ladder) applied to skills, gated by the agent-gateway's deterministic-first token ladder, and governed by the Lossless Distillation law (the source skill + losing candidates + lineage are PRESERVED, never replaced). Discovery != trust; skill output != truth; tool output != truth; tools are NEVER auto-published.

governance_law.statement: Skill and tool outputs are CANDIDATES, never authoritative truth. A promoted tool is deterministic GIVEN the same input + declared state; it does not make the surrounding agent deterministic (the agent still plans probabilistically). No generated tool is auto-published: every promotion requires sandbox + secret-scan + static-analysis + dependency-lock + SBOM + human/policy approval, and ships signed + versioned with a rollback target. Distillation is never replacement: the source skill, its lineage, the held-out eval set, and the LOSING candidate tools are preserved. SkillClaw is a research_candidate (MIT, WIP) and is NEVER run unchanged as production infra; skills are mined ONLY from public / synthetic / redacted-internal-non-sensitive traces, never customer / secrets / regulated / confidential data (and never through a low-cost or foreign processing lane).

skillclaw_entry.name: SkillClaw
skillclaw_entry.summary: Watches agent conversations via a local Client Proxy (OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions + /v1/messages) that records session artifacts and manages a local skill library; an optional Evolve Server reads sessions from shared storage (Alibaba OSS / S3 / local FS), detects repeated gaps/failure patterns, generates or evolves reusable SKILL.md skills (workflow engine = Summarize -> Aggregate -> Execute; or an agent engine), validates them against a set, and publishes them back to shared storage for collective reuse. Integrates with Hermes / Codex / Claude Code / OpenClaw / QwenPaw and other OpenAI-compatible agents.
skillclaw_entry.what_we_take: The OBSERVE -> DETECT-GAP -> GENERATE-SKILL -> VALIDATE -> INTEGRATE loop as a CANDIDATE source of skill drafts only.
skillclaw_entry.what_we_change_fork: We do not stop at re-injecting an evolved SKILL.md into the probabilistic agent loop, and we do not auto-publish to shared storage. We add a skill->tool COMPILER: a validated, repeatedly-reused skill becomes a deterministic, schema-bounded, sandboxed, secret-scanned, SBOM'd, human-approved, signed, versioned internal tool with a rollback target. Self-improvement happens OUT OF BAND and is promoted only through the gate.
risk_notes: WIP / experimental: API and skill format are unstable; pin a reviewed commit if ever vendored.
Default publish path writes evolved skills directly to shared storage ({group_id}/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) on threshold -> in our fork this is replaced by the promotion gate; nothing auto-publishes.

Cross-user collective evolution can carry one tenant's data into a shared skill -> our data_policy + lineage requirements forbid customer/secret/regulated/confidential traces and forbid tenant-private lineage becoming global.
Shared storage defaults include Alibaba OSS and processing may route through a low-cost / foreign lane -> never send sensitive traces; offline/local-only handling for any non-public trace.

Source conflict on maturity: opensourceprojects.dev presents it as WORK IN PROGRESS; the GitHub README reads more feature-complete. We treat it as WIP / research_candidate (the safer reading) until independently re-verified.

promotion_ladder.name: Observation
promotion_ladder.description: The Client Proxy (or our agent-gateway trace store) records agent conversations/tool calls; a gap detector finds repeated failures or repeated manual workarounds. Pure observation; nothing is created or trusted yet.

promotion_ladder.name: Draft skill (SKILL.md)
promotion_ladder.description: From the observed gap, generate a reusable SKILL.md (SkillClaw-style draft, or hand-authored). It is a CANDIDATE: it lives in a quarantine library and is never auto-published to shared/global storage.

promotion_ladder.name: Verified skill (held-out eval)
promotion_ladder.description: The skill must demonstrate capability LIFT on a HELD-OUT eval set (not the traces it was mined from) and must not regress. Tracks reuse count. Still probabilistic (it instructs an LLM); still not truth. A skill that makes things worse is rejected (the rejected candidate is preserved in lineage, not erased).

promotion_ladder.name: Tool candidate (compiled)
promotion_ladder.produces: tool.yaml + input/output JSON schema + src + unit/golden/property tests + security_manifest
promotion_ladder.description: The skill->tool COMPILER turns a sufficiently-reused, verified skill into a deterministic-tool CANDIDATE: a tool.yaml descriptor, input and output JSON Schemas, source implementing the deterministic core, unit + golden + property tests, and a security manifest declaring side-effects and sandbox caps. The source skill is retained as the documented fallback. Not yet proven deterministic.

promotion_ladder.name: Deterministic tool (proven)
promotion_ladder.description: The candidate must PASS the deterministic_tool_standard: no LLM calls, no unseeded randomness, no wall-clock dependency, N repeat runs produce the same output hash, sandbox caps hold (fs read-only/allowed-paths, network blocked, subprocess blocked), declared side-effects match observed, and tests pass (tool tests 100%). Deterministic GIVEN same input + declared state; the agent calling it stays probabilistic.

promotion_ladder.name: Certified internal tool (approved + registered)
promotion_ladder.description: After secret-scan + static-analysis + dependency-lock + SBOM pass AND a human/policy approver signs off, the tool is signed, versioned, and entered in the internal tool registry with a rollback target. Used deterministic-first by the agent-gateway, with the skill/LLM path as fallback for out-of-distribution inputs. Tool output is still a candidate the consumption gate must verify, never auto-served truth.

promotion_ladder.name: Retired / merged
promotion_ladder.description: A tool that is superseded, merged into a better tool, or whose underlying gap closed is RETIRED: the active pointer moves, monitoring stops, but the tool, its lineage, the source skill, the held-out eval, and the losing candidates are PRESERVED (lossless) and remain rollback/rehydration targets. Retired/merged != deleted.

deterministic_tool_standard.note: A 'deterministic tool' is deterministic GIVEN the same input + declared state. It does NOT make the calling agent deterministic; the agent still plans probabilistically and decides WHEN to call the tool. Tool output is a candidate, never authoritative truth.

data_policy.note: Skills and tools are mined ONLY from non-sensitive traces; sensitive data is never sent to any external evolver or low-cost/foreign processing lane.
